sources.text: Because of renovations nearby, one of the doors was not open, making it difficult to find. The hygiene is quite good, but the pillows smell. The bathroom is quite clean. The front desk staff are very warm and thoughtful, chatting and laughing. The hotel is quite literary and artistic, but the books in the room are too political. I thought that if you like Jane Austen, the boss would have more books about her, but he didn't. … Very good, beyond expectations, except for the loud air conditioner, everything else is very good, the location is super convenient, and the service attitude is also very good, recommended
